item.title: Grill Baskets from $11.99 at Woot
item.description: These heavy-duty stainless steel grill baskets come in a large size or a set with two small ones. The large basket is $11.99, and the set with two small baskets is $16.99.

item.title: Indoor Grill and Electric Griddle for $23.99 with Free Shipping
item.description: This indoor grill and electric griddle is available in beige or royal blue. The price is $23.99 with free shipping for Prime members.

item.title: JOFIOS Solar Post Cap Lights 12-Pack for $19.99 with Code
item.description: This 12-pack of JOFIOS solar post cap lights fits 4x4 posts and is available in black or white. The set is priced at $39.99, but a 50% coupon code brings it to $19.99 with free shipping for Prime members.

item.title: WORX Turbine 800-CFM Leaf Blower Drops to $49.99 at Lowe's
item.description: The WORX TURBINE 800-CFM 135-MPH corded electric leaf blower is available for $49.99 at Lowe's. This handheld blower delivers high air volume and speed for efficient yard cleanup.

item.title: Fenas Broom and Mop Holder with 5 Racks and 4 Hooks for $9.99
item.description: This wall-mounted organizer from Fenas holds brooms, mops, and other cleaning tools with five racks and four hooks. It is on sale for $9.99 after a $3.82 coupon discount, down from $19.99. Free shipping is available with Prime or on orders over $35.

item.title: 60" Garden Hoe 2-in-1 Cultivator Tool for $5.99 with Coupon
item.description: This 60-inch garden hoe doubles as a cultivator for weeding and soil loosening. It is currently priced at $11.99, but a 50% off coupon code reduces it to $5.99. Shipping is free with Prime or on orders over $35.

item.title: CRAFTSMAN V20 Leaf Blower Kit with Battery and Charger for $89.98
item.description: The CRAFTSMAN V20 Cordless Axial Leaf Blower Kit includes a 4.0 Ah battery and charger. It is available at Amazon for $89.98 with free shipping.

item.title: Traeger Pro 780 Grill Cover for $48.99 at Best Buy
item.description: This is a full-length cover designed for the Traeger Pro 780 grill. It is priced at $48.99 with free shipping from Best Buy.

item.title: Shark TruePet Upright Vacuum with HEPA Filter for $249.99
item.description: The Shark NV752 Rotator Powered Lift-Away TruePet Upright Vacuum includes a HEPA filter, large dust cup, LED headlights, and multiple tools. It is available for $249.99.

item.title: VEVOR 2900 PSI Gas Pressure Washer with Aluminum Pump for $148
item.description: This VEVOR gas pressure washer delivers 2900 PSI and 1.85 GPM, featuring an upgraded aluminum pump, spray gun, wand, and four nozzles. It is currently available for $148.

item.title: Apollo Tools 4-Piece Stubby Tool Set in Pink for $9.89
item.description: This four-piece stubby tool set from Apollo Tools features a compact design for easy storage in small spaces. The stubby tool design is useful for accessing tight and confined areas. The set is available in pink for $9.89.

item.title: Two-Pack of Grilling Aprons for $7.98 at Amazon
item.description: This deal offers a two-pack of Syntus aprons made from a poly/cotton blend, suitable for grilling or cooking. The price is $7.98 for the two aprons, with a black all-polyester version available for $6.98.

item.title: Feasto 30" Charcoal Barrel Grill with Side Burner, Cover for $159.99
item.description: This charcoal barrel grill from Feasto includes a side burner and a grill cover. It is available in black and is priced at $159.99 with free shipping from Wayfair.

item.title: Serrenf 2-Pack Bib Aprons for Grilling and Cooking at $8.09
item.description: These bib aprons from Serrenf come in a two-pack and feature pockets, making them suitable for grilling and cooking tasks. The price is $8.09 after clipping a coupon on the Amazon product page.

item.title: Costway Folding Grill Cart for Griddles Drops to $90 at Walmart
item.description: This folding grill cart from Costway fits 17- and 22-inch griddles and includes a heat-resistant mat and wheels. It is available at Walmart for $90 with free shipping.

item.title: Costway Grill Cart with Prep Table and Storage for $150 at Walmart
item.description: The Costway Outdoor Grill Cart is a movable prep table with storage cabinet and shelves, designed for BBQ use. It is available at Walmart for $150 with free shipping.

item.title: PARGRILL Folding Grill Cart with Side Table for $110 at Walmart
item.description: This PARGRILL outdoor folding grill cart includes a pull-out side table and a griddle stand that fits 17-inch or 22-inch grills. It is priced at $110 with free shipping from Walmart, making it a practical addition for outdoor cooking setups.

item.title: Walmart offers Expert Grill BBQ Prep Cart for $176 with free shipping
item.description: The Expert Grill Outdoor BBQ Prep Cart features a stainless steel top, storage shelves, and wheels for easy mobility. Walmart is currently selling it for $176 with free shipping.

item.title: Greenworks 24V String Trimmer with Battery and Charger for $79
item.description: This cordless string trimmer from Greenworks operates on a 24V battery and includes a 2.0 Ah battery and charger. It is priced at $79 with free shipping.

item.title: Olympia Tools Portable Carrier with Telescopic Handle for $13.99
item.description: The Olympia Tools 85-010 Grand Pack-N-Roll is a portable tools carrier with a telescopic handle and an 80-pound load capacity. It is currently available for $13.99, making it a practical option for organizing and transporting tools.

item.title: HOTEC 2-Pack Silicone Basting Brushes for $5.99
item.description: This set includes two silicone basting brushes that are heat resistant up to 600°F and made from BPA-free, food-grade materials. They are suitable for spreading oil, butter, sauce, and marinades on grilled or baked foods, and are dishwasher safe. The brushes are available for $5.99.

item.title: Char-Broil Folding Chicken Roaster for $4.99 at Amazon
item.description: The Char-Broil folding chicken roaster is a stainless steel accessory for grilling, designed to hold a chicken upright for beer can or vertical roasting. It is currently available for $4.99 at Amazon, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: Kingsford Hickory Wood Pellets for Grilling, 20 lbs, $12.89
item.description: Kingsford Premium Hickory Wood Pellets are 100% natural hardwood pellets for grilling and smoking. Amazon offers them at $14.39 with a coupon bringing the price to $12.89. Free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: Oklahoma Joe's Hickory Wood Chips Bag for $4.99
item.description: Oklahoma Joe's Hickory Wood Chips are made from 100% natural seasoned hardwood with no unwanted byproducts, burning cleanly and evenly. The 192 cubic inch bag is priced at $4.99, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: EWFEN 35-Piece Griddle Accessories Kit for $28.48
item.description: This kit includes 35 pieces of griddle accessories, such as spatulas and other tools, designed for flat top grills like Blackstone and Camp Chef. The set is currently available for $28.48.

item.title: Eufy Doorbell Camera with HomeBase 3 Drops to $218.99 at Macy's
item.description: This bundle includes the Eufy video doorbell and the HomeBase 3 hub, which provides local storage and smart home integration. The deal is available at Macy's, sold by Anker, the parent company of Eufy, at a price lower than typical electronics retailers.

item.title: RIDGID 18V Battery Kit with 2x 8Ah and 2x 4Ah Batteries for $171
item.description: This starter kit includes two 8Ah EXP batteries, two 4Ah batteries, and a charger. The price is $171 with free shipping, available for today only at Home Depot.

item.title: Ace Hardware Cuts Craftsman Tools Up to 67% Off
item.description: Ace Hardware's early Labor Day sale includes clearance prices on Craftsman V20 power tools, mechanic's sets, outdoor equipment, and S2000 tool storage. Prices start at $14.99, with savings up to 67%.

item.title: Suncast 8x10 Resin Storage Shed with Floor for $1103.18
item.description: The Suncast Tremont is an 8x10-foot resin outdoor storage shed with 547 cubic feet of space, a floor, lockable double doors, and skylights. It is designed to hold lawn tools, riding mowers, and bikes. This deal offers the shed at $1103.18.

item.title: Farberware 18-Inch Stainless Steel BBQ Turner Spatula for $10.99
item.description: This Farberware BBQ turner spatula features an 18-inch stainless steel construction with a black handle, designed for flipping meat, fish, and vegetables on the grill. It is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. The spatula is available for $10.99 with free shipping for Prime members.
